ValidationRule.description: Mandatory Fields when 'On Hold With Internal Or External Party' is internal
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'IDR_Task', ISPICKVAL( Type , 'Pend Case'), ISPICKVAL(IDR_Internal_or_External_Party__c,'Internal (ANZ)'), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT( On_Hold_Reason_Internal__c )), ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Portfolio_or_Business_Unit__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Tribe__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Team__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Following fields are mandatory if 'On Hold With Internal Or External Party' is Internal (ANZ) - Division, Business Unit, Business Unit-1, On Hold Reason
